title: MASJID HAI QATALGA HAI JANAB E AMEER
body:
PESHANI KOON MEI TAR HAI NABI KE WAZEER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
BADLA LIYA GAYA HAI ALI SE NAMAZ MEI
THI USHMANI RASOOL SE ROZE GHADEER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAINAB NE JANE KAISE ÉLAN YEH SUNA
MAIYAT UTHAYE JAYE JANABE AMEER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
MUSLIM SE BOLEY MOULA NABI KA SAFEER HOON
IS SHEHER MEI YEH HOT HOTI HAI HALAT SAFEER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
SHABBIR DEKTEY HAI YATEEMON KI EK QATAR
ZAQHMI ALI KO IS GHADI HAJAT HAI SHIR KI
<<DIVIDER>>
TARIQ SE SAWAL HAI GARCIAGAR KUFI SHIA THEY
UN KUFIYUN NEY ALEY NABI KYUN ASEER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
AKBAR YEH FAIZ MIDHATEY ALEY BATOOL HAI
JHOOLI BHARI HOVI HAI NAJAF KE FAKHEER KI
